name: 08_stt_invalid_key
description: Resilience (scripted): the primary STT (Groq Whisper) is given an invalid key (non-retryable); the chain must go straight to local faster-whisper and the turn proceeds normally.
replies: Your order PN-10002, the smart scale, shipped three days ago by BlueDart express. The tracking number is B D 7 7 8 1 2 0 4 I N. BlueDart expects to deliver it in about two days. You'll get an SMS from the courier on the day of delivery.
